preconditions.description: The number of rows n and columns m must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row in the grid must have exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '.X' for row in grid for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each character in the grid must be either '.' or 'X'.

preconditions.expression: all(grid[i][j] != 'X' for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if i == 0 or i == n-1 or j == 0 or j == m-1)
preconditions.description: No marked cells 'X' can be adjacent to the edge of the grid.

postconditions.description: If no suitable grid exists, output 'NO'; otherwise, output 'YES' followed by n lines of m integers.

postconditions.expression: all(int(cell) in {1, 4} for row in grid for cell in row if cell != 'X')
postconditions.description: Every unmarked cell must contain either the number 1 or 4.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(int(grid[i-1][j]) if i > 0 else 0 + int(grid[i+1][j]) if i < n-1 else 0 + int(grid[i][j-1]) if j > 0 else 0 + int(grid[i][j+1]) if j < m-1 else 0) % 5 == 0 for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if grid[i][j] == 'X')
postconditions.description: Every marked cell must contain a multiple of 5, which is the sum of adjacent unmarked cells.
